checks.result: Export → typed RESET → undo restores roster/NPCs/inventory/slot refine/wallet/story exactly (unit) and on the real stack (#63 → reset #64 → restore #65 with identical roster/items/wallet); the exported file carries the signed tip and no secrets.

An older-content signed save returns SAVE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED with a before/after preview; save.migrate first copies the signed row as a 'migration' backup then writes revision+1 on current content (unit + live #67→#68). Newer schema → UPDATE_REQUIRED, unknown definition → MIGRATION_UNSUPPORTED, both with no write; malformed/foreign files are rejected by the reader.

Reset/restore are CAS revisions (stale → REVISION_CONFLICT, same request id replays without a second write). The restored AFK cursor never moves back (only the 3h post-reset window pays, not 8h), today's shop/daily counters survive reset and restore, a reset backup restores once, forged signatures and other accounts are refused. A tampered row is recovered only from its signed tip.

The Backup sheet shows cloud-vs-file and current-vs-backup tables before any overwrite; reset needs typed RESET; the maintenance panels (migration/recovery) list what changes; toasts appear only after the receipt, and the client only sends the maintenance write whose revision the server detail named.

Compatibility matrix fixtures: current / older content (migratable) / schema 2 (unsupported) / unknown item ID (blocked) / file relations (same/older/newer/diverged/other account); a skill bought at cost v0 (60 gold, 12 manuals) refunds exactly that after migration, not today's price, and a second reset refunds 0.
